name: PAC-NeRF
aliases: Physics Augmented Continuum Neural Radiance Fields
definition: A dynamic neural radiance field that estimates both unknown geometry and physical parameters of highly dynamic objects from multi-view videos without assuming object geometry or topology. It enforces continuum mechanics conservation laws by using a hybrid Eulerian-Lagrangian representation.
summary: PAC-NeRF estimates 3D geometry and physical parameters of dynamic objects from multi-view videos by enforcing continuum mechanics conservation laws via a differentiable Material Point Method, unlike standard NeRFs that learn dynamics from scratch.
